A '''clone of Sate Pestage''' was created by the original [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] in preparation for his retreat to [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].<ref name="NEGTC" /> When this rapidly gestated clone developed [[clone madness]], [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Sarcev Quest]] abandoned it to the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] and [[Ysanne Isard]].<ref name="TEP48">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref> The clone of Pestage was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Delak Krennel]]<ref name="SWB" /> on [[Ciutric IV]] in [[5 ABY]],<ref name="MR">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 35|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 35]]</ref> while the real Pestage was killed when the [[Galaxy Gun]] [[Destruction of Byss|destroyed Byss]]<ref name="NEGTC" /> in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
